sentences.en: Several factors affecting the spirality of aramid knitted fabrics made by the flat knitting machine were discussed.

sentences.en: Add the specification that "Spirality after washing will not be tested on the rib and elastic lap."

sentences.en: Spirality knitting fabric has bothered enterprises for a long time, and has made bad influences to the appearance of garment.

sentences.en: Therefore, if you want to decrease the spirality , you should find a method to decrease the yarn twist liveliness.

sentences.en: Extended spirality searching model of dipping sonar and submarine moving models were built.

sentences.en: This thesis will try to decrease spirality by using steaming process.

sentences.en: Against error accumulation and computation complexity, a novel spirality interpolation sequence scheme is assumed, whichimproves precision of interpolation and reduces maximum error of interpolation.

sentences.en: This paper introduces Plato' circle leturing and analyzes its four characteristics: arrangement, spirality, connection, and openness.

sentences.en: It analyses and designs the method to test the twist liveliness of yarns and the index to test the spirality angle of the fabric.
